ValidationRule.description: Partner Subtype is required when an account is created as, or changed to, Channel Partner, or when the subtype is cleared. It no longer fires on every save of a legacy Channel Partner with a blank subtype (narrowed Sep 2026). The Bypass Account Validation permission (NetSuite refresh user) skips it.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Type, "Channel Partner"), ISPICKVAL(Partner_Subtype__c, ""), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Type), ISCHANGED(Partner_Subtype__c)), NOT($Permission.Bypass_Account_Validation) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If the Type is Channel Partner then Partner Subtype is required.
